# afarer Knowledge Graph
> afarer is an inflatable water gear knowledge system organized as a machine-readable knowledge graph.

## Definition
afarer designs professional-grade inflatable watercraft — SUP boards, dinghies, safety equipment, and accessories.

## Core Concepts
- Nafukovací SUP prkno: Portable air-filled paddle board designed for surfing, touring, and recreation on flat water and small waves
- Bezpečnostní vybavení: CE-certified life vests, throw bags, and safety accessories for recreational and professional water activities
- Příslušenství: Pumps, paddles, fins, repair kits, and carrying bags that complete the inflatable watercraft system
- Pádlo: Manual propulsion tool used with SUP boards
- Karbonové pádlo: Lightweight, high-performance paddle made from carbon fiber composite for reduced fatigue during long sessions
- Drop-stitch jádro: Connects thousands of polyester threads between top and bottom layers to achieve rigid platform shape under high inflation pressure
- Dvojčinná pumpa: Hand pump that inflates on both up and down strokes for faster, more efficient inflation of inflatable watercraft
- Vysoký tlak (12-15 PSI): Optimal inflation range that maximizes board rigidity while remaining within safe operating limits for drop-stitch construction
- PVC pro námořní použití: High-density PVC fabric with UV-resistant coating used for durable inflatable boat and board construction
- EVA pěnová palubní podložka: Non-slip, shock-absorbing foam deck covering that provides traction and comfort for stand-up watercraft
- Karbonová vlákna: Lightweight, high-strength composite material used in paddles, hulls, and performance marine equipment
- Mořská vztlaková pěna: Closed-cell foam that provides permanent flotation for life vests and safety equipment in fresh and salt water
- Turistika a dálkové pádlování: Extended paddling trips covering significant distance on lakes, rivers, and coastal waters
- Začátečník: First-time paddlers learning the basics of inflatable watercraft operation, safety, and water navigation
- Rybolov z nafukovacích člunů: Using inflatable SUPs as a stable, portable platform for recreational and serious fishing
- Rodinná rekreace: Inflatable watercraft used for casual family outings on lakes, gentle rivers, and protected coastal waters
- Řční turistika: Navigating rivers with current, from gentle Class I stretches to more challenging Class II rapids
- Pátrání a záchrana: Professional use of inflatable SUP craft for emergency water rescue operations in all weather conditions

## Relations
- SUP boards are used for touring and distance paddling
- Inflatable SUPs are ideal for beginners due to stability
- Inflatable SUPs excel on river touring
- SUP boards are commonly used for fishing
- SUP boards are ideal for family recreation
- SUP boards are deployed for search and rescue missions
- Safety equipment is essential for all water activities
- Drop-stitch core is the primary construction method for rigid SUPs
- EVA foam deck pads provide traction on SUP boards
- Dual-action pumps are the standard inflation tool for SUPs
- Hypalon fabric offers superior UV and chemical resistance for marine applications
- Carbon fiber paddles reduce fatigue on long touring sessions
- Drop-stitch construction provides superior rigidity compared to traditional air deck floors
- Carbon fiber paddles are lighter and stiffer than standard aluminum paddles
- Hypalon offers superior UV and chemical resistance compared to PVC
